content: Vikram Singh from ProtectAll Agency called customer Kiara Sen to confirm updates to her DCoders home insurance policy (H-2026-0459) following the addition of a 55-inch 4K television valued at $1,200. Vikram verified the TV's serial number and receipt, added it to her personal property coverage, and confirmed the smartwatch sub-limit. The updates increased her monthly premium by $12, bringing the new total to $84 per month under a $150,000 personal property limit. The policy status was successfully updated to active.
